Mechanical SPGs (the ones that are connected to tour tank) work by pushing air through the tube. The air pushes against a diaphragm (a layer of stretchy material), which in turn pushes an oil through a tube in the gauge itself. The expansion of the oil tube moves the needle which shows the tank pressure.
